data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 116.486m. During 2018 the syndicate recorded a gross strengthening of prior year provisions of GBP 48.098m (c.41.3% of opening gross claims), driven largely by adverse development from prior-year natural catastrophe events (notably the September 2017 storms in the south-eastern USA and Caribbean and two earthquakes in Mexico, collectively referred to as 'HIMM') and associated large loss development and reinsurance recoverable movements. The reconciliation of incurred claims outstanding shows the prior year provision movement of GBP 48.098m (gross).
